name: Efferocytosis, scavenger receptor uptake, RAGE signaling and hyaluronan breakdown
rationale: Members cover apoptotic-cell recognition/engulfment, class A/B/F/H scavenging and immune-complex clearance, plus RAGE signaling and hyaluronan degradation that the microglial/oxLDL confusables lack, and no lysosomal-organization members unlike the superset theme.

core: Scavenger receptor efferocytosis and hyaluronan breakdown
name: Scavenger receptor efferocytosis, hyaluronan breakdown and lysosome organization
rationale: Members share scavenger-receptor and apoptotic-cell clearance with hyaluronan catabolism, and uniquely add lysosomal/endosomal proteins, lysosome organization, cholesterol storage and protein import that the 15-member sibling lacks.

name: SNARE-driven vesicle priming and fusion in transmitter release cycles
rationale: Members are the dopamine/glutamate/ACh/noradrenaline/serotonin release cycles plus vesicle docking, SNARE assembly, priming and positive regulation of fusion, without the negative-regulation and presynaptic-modulation members of its superset.

name: Presynaptic facilitation and inhibition of calcium-dependent vesicle exocytosis
rationale: Members share synaptic vesicle docking, priming and calcium-triggered release, and uniquely include negative regulation of calcium-dependent and synaptic vesicle exocytosis and presynaptic modulation, i.e. bidirectional control.

name: Oxaloacetate, malate and 2-oxoglutarate turnover linking pyruvate and aspartate
rationale: Members are TCA dicarboxylate intermediates, the malate-aspartate shuttle, aspartate metabolism and pyruvate transport/turnover, without the succinate-dehydrogenase and ATP-synthesis members of the larger sibling or the PDH/CoA members of other confusables.

name: TCA cycle, aspartate shuttle and succinate-linked oxidative ATP synthesis
rationale: Members span TCA intermediates, malate-aspartate shuttle and pyruvate handling, and uniquely add succinate metabolism, succinate-to-ubiquinone electron transport and proton-motive ATP synthesis.

name: TCR-CD28 signaling through second-messenger generation and CTLA4/BTLA co-inhibition
rationale: Members cover CD3/ZAP-70 proximal TCR signaling, CD28 Vav1/PI3K costimulation and CTLA4/BTLA co-inhibition, adding generation of second messengers versus the smaller sibling while lacking the differentiation members of the larger one.

name: TCR-CD28 signaling and co-inhibition extending to T cell differentiation
rationale: Members share TCR, CD28 and CTLA4/BTLA signaling and uniquely add ITK/PKC-driven differentiation, CD8 alpha-beta and gamma-delta T cell differentiation, the IL2/IL7 network and RHOH.

name: Proximal CD3-ZAP-70 and CD28 signaling under CTLA4/BTLA restraint
rationale: Members are the proximal TCR steps (CD3 zeta phosphorylation, ZAP-70 translocation), CD28 Vav1/PI3K costimulation, IL-2 induction and CTLA4/BTLA co-inhibition, lacking second-messenger and differentiation members of the larger siblings.

name: Cytosolic and mitochondrial tRNA charging with t6A and wobble modification
rationale: Members are cytosolic and mitochondrial tRNA aminoacylation and t6A/wobble uridine thiolation/guanine modifications for fidelity, without the selenocysteine, splicing and readthrough members of the larger sibling.

name: tRNA charging, anticodon modification, splicing and selenocysteine recoding
rationale: Members share tRNA aminoacylation and anticodon modification for fidelity and uniquely add selenocysteine synthesis, tRNA intron splicing and translational readthrough.

core: K2P leak-channel control of resting potential
name: K2P leak-channel control of nociceptor resting potential and pain
rationale: Members are TWIK/TREK/TASK/THIK/TRESK channels with resting-potential, action-potential and pain/thermal detection terms, lacking TALK, itch and fever members of the larger sibling.

core: Two-pore potassium channels in sensory perception
name: Two-pore potassium channels in pain, itch, fever and thermosensation
rationale: Members share K2P channel families with pain and temperature detection, and uniquely add TALK channels, sensory perception of itch, fever generation and neuronal action potential regulation.

name: KIT mutant resistance across seven kinase inhibitors including dasatinib
rationale: All members are KIT mutant TKI binding/resistance entries, spanning dasatinib, nilotinib, masitinib and sorafenib beyond the imatinib/sunitinib/regorafenib core of the smaller sibling.

name: Imatinib, sunitinib and regorafenib resistance of KIT mutants
rationale: Members are KIT mutant TKI binding plus resistance to exactly the three GIST-line drugs imatinib, sunitinib and regorafenib, unlike the broader seven-drug sibling and PDGFR/FLT3 confusables.

name: ERBB and MET receptor internalization and multivesicular-body degradation
rationale: Members cover ubiquitin-dependent endocytosis, MVB sorting to the vacuole and EGFR/ERBB2-3/ERBB4 downregulation plus InlB-MET-mediated Listeria entry, without the nuclear ERBB4 and PTEN-stability members of the larger sibling.

name: ERBB receptor endocytic turnover with nuclear ERBB4 and PTEN regulation
rationale: Members share ubiquitin-dependent ERBB endocytic downregulation and uniquely add nuclear ERBB4 signaling, PTEN stability/localization and protein autophosphorylation.

name: Proteostasis via ubiquitin-deubiquitinase balance, proteasome and selective autophagy
rationale: Members span ubiquitin chain synthesis, proteasome and misfolded-protein control, and uniquely add USP/OTU/metalloprotease DUBs, aggrephagy, chaperone-mediated and microautophagy, COP9 signalosome and stress-granule regulation.

name: Ubiquitin chain-type assembly, degron recognition and proteasomal turnover
rationale: Members are linkage-specific ubiquitination (K6/K11/K27/K29/K48, branched), N-end and C-degron pathways, ERAD regulation and proteasomal catabolism of misfolded proteins, lacking the DUB families and autophagy members of the larger sibling.

qualifier: bidirectional proliferation, migration and differentiation control
name: Bidirectional control of vascular smooth muscle proliferation, migration and differentiation
rationale: Members are paired positive/negative regulation of VSMC proliferation, migration, apoptosis and differentiation with phenotypic switching, without the aortic morphogenesis, endothelial activation and matrix adhesion members of the larger sibling.

name: Vascular smooth muscle switching with aortic morphogenesis and endothelial activation
rationale: Members share VSMC phenotypic switching and remodeling regulation and uniquely add aorta smooth muscle morphogenesis, endothelial cell activation and smooth muscle cell-matrix adhesion.

core: Virus entry, protein maturation and assembly
name: Virus entry, protein maturation and host junction-signaling subversion
rationale: Members share viral attachment, entry, protein maturation and budding, and uniquely add SARS-CoV PDZ/junction and host-signaling targeting, dengue apoptosis modulation and host suppression of invasion.

core: Receptor-mediated virus entry and protein maturation
name: Receptor-mediated virus entry, structural protein maturation and budding assembly
rationale: Members are restricted to attachment/entry, maturation of spike/E/3a/nucleoprotein/DENV/RSV/Env proteins and assembly at the budding site, lacking the host-junction and apoptosis-targeting members of the larger sibling.

name: Vitamin K turnover, coagulation-factor gamma-carboxylation and ascorbate metabolism
rationale: Members share gamma-carboxylation and ascorbate metabolism and uniquely add vitamin K/menaquinone catabolism and defective F9 gamma-carboxylation.

qualifier: vitamin C, E and K responses
name: Gamma-carboxylated protein processing and vitamin C, E and K responses
rationale: Members are gamma-carboxylation, transport and propeptide removal of carboxylated proteins with ascorbate metabolism and responses to vitamins C, E and K, without the vitamin K catabolism and F9 defect members of the larger sibling.
